description.html: The HabiStat Sliding Glass Door Lock is a simple lock for terrariums and cabinets with sliding glass doors. It locks two sliding glass panes together, so the doors cannot move until you unlock them. The pack contains the lock with a 90 mm ratchet arm and two keys.

The lock is reversible and can be fitted on either side of the glass. It is useful when there are children or other pets in the home, and many lizards and snakes can push a sliding pane open and escape.

According to the manufacturer's instructions, the ratchet arm screws onto one pane, with no drilling required. The lock body then slides along the arm until it butts up against the edge of the front sliding pane, and you turn the key to lock or unlock it. Before buying, check that your terrarium has two overlapping sliding panes.
Keep the keys somewhere safe, out of reach of children. We build custom glass terrariums with sliding doors; read more on our terrariums page.
